zh-Hant.name: 紫微八字
zh-Hant.subtitle: 排盤、心情紀錄與歷史趨勢
zh-Hant.promotionalText: 把傳統排盤與每日狀態放在一起觀察。紀錄心情、精力與筆記，查看自己的歷史趨勢，透過 JSON／CSV 保留備份。此離線版本沒有 AI 服務或雲端同步。
zh-Hant.keywords: 農曆曆法,天干地支,五行觀察,心情日記,精力紀錄,流日曆法,資料備份
zh-Hant.description:
紫微八字把傳統命盤與個人日誌放在同一個地方，讓你回看自己的紀錄與曆法資訊。

• 查看紫微斗數與八字本命盤，以及選定日期的流年、流月、流日資訊。
• 每天記錄 1–5 分的心情與精力，加上狀態標籤與筆記；可編輯或刪除記錄。
• 累積至少兩筆記錄後，查看心情與精力走勢，以及依曆法欄位、狀態標籤分組的歷史平均。
• 累積至少 10 筆包含所選指標的紀錄後，流日預覽提供同類流日歷史平均的統計參考。
• 在裝置內保存資料，使用 JSON 備份與合併匯入，或透過 iOS 分享面板匯出 JSON／CSV。

此版本提供離線核心功能，沒有 AI 服務、雲端同步或登入帳號。選擇分享目的地時，該 App 或服務可能依自己的政策處理你交付的檔案。

五個核心分頁可切換英文與繁體中文；星曜、宮名、干支等細部傳統命盤術語與 CSV 欄名仍保留中文。出生時間依輸入值計算，未做出生地時區、夏令時間不存在／重複時刻判別或真太陽時校正；國際出生資訊不可直接視為已校正。流日計算以所選日期中午 12:00 為參考。

命理內容屬文化性詮釋；圖表與歷史平均預覽屬個人資料的相關性觀察，沒有經科學驗證的預測效力，也不構成醫療、心理健康或財務建議。

公開品牌：lwbro
支援信箱：lwbro@me.com
zh-Hant.reviewNotes:
1019c38 候選的五個核心分頁可切換英文／繁中；細部傳統命盤術語與 CSV 欄名仍保留中文，候選原生 UI 尚未驗證。離線首版，無帳號或登入需求。核心曆法與排盤資源均隨 App 提供；沒有 AI 服務、雲端同步、廣告、App 內購買或自動診斷回報。 首版免費下載已由 Kurt 確認；後續商業模式僅作探索，沒有新增購買、廣告或 AI 服務。

測試步驟：設定 → 使用合成資料（2000-01-01、12:00、女；姓名可填示範人物）→ 儲存 → 本命盤。今日流運 → 選定日期 → 記錄心情／精力。建立兩筆以上記錄後可查看趨勢分析；歷史平均預覽需要至少 10 筆相應指標資料。記錄 → 匯出 JSON／CSV 使用 iOS 分享面板；匯入 JSON 使用系統 Files picker，5 MB 上限。JSON 依日期合併，較新的更新時間優先，本機已有出生資料時不覆蓋該資料。

命理內容是文化性詮釋。統計圖呈現使用者日誌的相關性，沒有預測保證；出生地時區、夏令時間不存在／重複時刻判別與真太陽時校正未實作；全球產品目標不代表全球算法已驗證。

本次首版範圍已確定為離線命盤、日誌、趨勢與備份。正式導覽只有今日流運、本命盤、記錄、趨勢分析與設定；沒有 AI、同步、登入或購買入口。AI／OAuth／同步實作與 CDN 備援未打包，網路連線由離線 CSP 阻擋。網頁版未來功能保留在原始碼。

此草稿不能直接送審：公開隱私／支援 URL、私人審查聯絡、App Store Connect 紀錄、distribution 簽名、最終聲明及 iPhone Files／實機驗證仍待完成。先前 9f737e0 開發版安裝與基本啟動成功；1019c38 只有背景檢查及 generic unsigned simulator 編譯通過，尚未完成原生 UI 驗證，不能視為送審包或完整功能驗證。

en-US.name: Ziwei Bazi Journal
en-US.subtitle: Charts, moods and local backup
en-US.promotionalText: Explore traditional charts, record mood and energy, and keep local backups. Core screens support English and Traditional Chinese; detailed chart terms remain Chinese.
en-US.description:
Core screens support English and Traditional Chinese. Detailed traditional chart terms, including star, palace and stem/branch names, remain in Chinese. CSV column headings also remain Chinese.

Ziwei Bazi Journal brings traditional Chinese charts and your personal daily notes together for reflection.

• View Ziwei Doushu and Bazi natal charts, plus calendar-based information for a selected date.
• Record mood and energy on a 1–5 scale, with tags and notes. Edit or delete entries as needed.
• With at least two entries, view mood and energy history and grouped historical averages.
• With at least 10 entries containing the selected metric, a day preview compares historical averages from similar calendar groups.
• Keep data on your device. Export JSON or CSV with the iOS share sheet, and import JSON backups to merge records.

Core features work offline. This version has no AI service, cloud sync, account login, or in-app purchases. A destination you select for sharing may process the file under its own policies.

Birth date and time are used as entered. Birthplace time-zone conversion, DST gap/overlap handling and true-solar-time correction are not implemented. International birth data should not be treated as a corrected chart. Daily calculations use noon on the selected date.

Astrological interpretations are cultural content. Charts and historical-average previews describe associations in your journal; they have no scientifically validated predictive accuracy and do not provide medical, mental-health, or financial advice.

Public-facing brand: lwbro
Support email: lwbro@me.com
en-US.reviewNotes:
Offline first release; no account or login is required. Calendar and chart resources are bundled. No AI service, cloud sync, ads, in-app purchases, or automatic diagnostic reporting is enabled. The 1019c38 candidate supports English and Traditional Chinese core screens using the Language control. Detailed traditional chart terms and CSV column headings remain Chinese; this update has not been installed or verified through native iOS UI. Kurt confirmed free download for the first release. Future business models remain exploratory; no purchases, ads or AI services are activated.

Suggested review flow: Settings (設定) → enter fictitious data (2000-01-01, 12:00, female; optional name: Demo) → Save → Birth chart (本命盤). Daily (今日流運) → choose a date → save mood/energy. Create at least two entries for trend charts; the historical-average preview needs at least 10 entries with the selected metric. Entries (記錄) → export JSON/CSV using the iOS share sheet, or import JSON through the system Files picker (5 MB maximum). Import merges by date, prefers a newer updatedAt value, and retains an existing local birth profile.

Interpretations are cultural content; journal statistics describe associations and do not promise predictive accuracy. Birthplace time-zone conversion, DST gap/overlap handling and true-solar-time correction are not implemented. The global product target is not a verified worldwide calculation capability.

The first-release scope is approved: offline charts, journal, trends and backups. Navigation contains Daily, Birth chart, Entries, Trends and Settings only. There are no AI, sync, login or purchase entry points. AI/OAuth/sync implementations and CDN fallback are excluded from this native package; the offline CSP blocks connections. Future web implementations remain in source.

DO NOT SUBMIT this draft yet: public privacy/support URLs, private review contact, App Store Connect record, distribution signing, final declarations, and manual iPhone Files/physical checks must be completed. The earlier 9f737e0 development build installed and launched; 1019c38 has background checks and generic unsigned simulator compilation only. Its native UI has not been verified. Neither milestone establishes an upload-ready distribution build or complete functional validation.

Public-facing brand: lwbro
Support email: lwbro@me.com
